source: docs/simple-experiments-plan.md, section Scope, conventions and the development set, with the 3 held-out-dataset members swapped as protocol step 2 asks

models.role: second WaNet model, below the 2-point clean bar
models.why: The plan names it for this swap. It clears the ASR bar and fails only the 2-point clean-accuracy bar, so it is labeled and never pooled with panel models. `vit_cifar10_wanet_0_05` fails the same bar and lacks an adaptive rate for `pre_residual_blocks_9_12`, so it would drop out of X3.

models.role: BPP at the highest poison rate
models.why: The 3 remaining CIFAR-10 and GTSRB BPP panel models are `vit_cifar10_bpp_0_01`, `vit_cifar10_bpp_0_1` and `vit_gtsrb_bpp_0_05`. The CIFAR-10 ones have no adaptive rate for `pre_residual_blocks_9_12`. Of the 2 GTSRB ones the 10% model spans the rate range with the 1% and 5% members already in the set.

models.role: LF at the same poison rate as the member it replaces
models.why: It has the attack and rate of the replaced member. `vit_cifar10_lf_0_01` has no adaptive rate for `pre_residual_blocks_9_12`, while the GTSRB model carries every placement X3 and X4 read.
